trigger.note: no round-level trigger pid. RedHotRespin (ST5) is a FREE cost=0 reel spin on a premium reel skin (ReelSkin=2) that extends the triggering paid ST1 spin (cost=1000, ReelSkin=1). The trigger marker is the numeric ST1 ReMarks value in {2,3,4,5}: every such ST1 round is IMMEDIATELY followed by exactly one ST5 (4390/4390 observed); empty-ReMarks ST1 returns to ST1. ST5 always runs length 1 and returns to ST1. Both STs settle natively via PayoutIdToWinAmount (no synthesis) — same archetype as M43 ST50 WinRespin / M279 ST36 MoveSpin (win-driven free reel extension).

validation.evidence: Fleet-batch manifest-only onboard 2026-06-18. Provenance: all 5 chunks _cache_version:3 (REAL), single md5 bucket f77e0a5b/f68454a5, _bet=1000 — NOT virtual. ST1 (160000 rounds, 97.33%) = paid base game, CostCredits=1000, ReelSkin=1, win via native PayoutIdToWinAmount (14719 winning rounds have non-empty payid map, exact). ST5 (4390 rounds, 2.67%) = FREE cost=0 reel respin, ReelSkin=2, 100% win>0, native PayoutIdToWinAmount. Server analysisResult FeatureWin taxonomy = exactly {Normal, RedHotRespin} -> play names confirmed verbatim. Sequence proof: ST5 is ALWAYS preceded by ST1 (predOf5={1:4390}), run-length always 1, and ST1 with ReMarks in {2,3,4,5} ALWAYS triggers the next ST5 (1167/1632/1320/271) -> RedHotRespin is a win-driven free reel extension of the paid spin = `respin` role (M43/M279 archetype, strict field-signature match). NO live-collect channel: SymbolIndexToRewards / CollectCount / CreditsSymbols / AccCredits all ABSENT (0 populated). No no-payid settlement ST -> no SynthesizePayIdRule needed. CurJackpotStoreWin present on 100% of rounds but =0 on 100% (test-interface-zeroed, fleet-wide). NOT YET user-signed (status=auto); report_engine smoke + console render gate pending coordinator.
caveats: ST5 RedHotRespin trigger gate (which paid-spin outcomes / ReMarks value open a respin, and why ReMarks in {2,3,4,5}) is a server-side decision not fully derivable from rawdata — the grant correlation (ST1 ReMarks in {2,3,4,5} -> next ST5, 4390/4390) is observed but the gating rule is not. Same boundary as M43 ST50 respin trigger gate.

ST5 respin burst-length is trivially 1 in this sample (every respin runs length 1); a multi-respin chain, if structurally possible, would need per-round run-length accumulation in parser.py (base-closure) — respin_dynamics surfaces continuation_prob base-excluded and flags the histogram parser_blind. out_of_engine_mechanics.name: CurJackpotStoreWin progressive (test-interface-zeroed)
out_of_engine_mechanics.desc: Field 'CurJackpotStoreWin' is present on every ST1/ST5 round but =0 on 100% of the 164390 in-sample records. FLEET-WIDE test-interface behavior (user-confirmed 2026-06-12, recorded once per machine): it is a real progressive jackpot store, but the current testspin interface forces its accumulation to 0 (so the sample correctly shows 0). Parse the data as-is with the progressive contributing 0; the field is already in the ST1/ST5 signature, so parsing is FORWARD-COMPATIBLE — when the test interface is optimized to populate it, the existing parser picks it up unchanged. The data RTP is the BASE RTP (excludes the progressive); it grows when the field is enabled.
